judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type names entirely (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` field, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list` with `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, and `ConversationSummary`. Validation in the candidate allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, directly violating the acceptance criteria requiring `limit` to be an integer between 1 and 200 (rejecting 0 and 201). Furthermore, `createMessageHandler`'s second parameter `sessionStore` was made required (`sessionStore: SessionStore`), which breaks existing 1-arg unit tests of `createMessageHandler` and crashes if `sessionStore` is undefined when destructuring `const {listFor} = sessionStore`. The candidate also missed updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `StoreCannotList`, and several required acceptance tests (such as streaming lock bypass and end-to-end resume).
